title: Workstream fact kinds
description: Registry of canonical fact kinds (ADR 0004). A kind must be registered here before any code may append it. Payload schemas are JSON Schema 2020-12 documents under contracts/schemas/. Grounding names the normative section the kind exists for; kinds without a normative home are not registered.

sessionScoped.description: True when the fact must reference exactly one session_id (ADR 0004: every canonical fact references exactly one Session).

kinds.grounding: execution.md — Session birth and admission: birth pins cutoff H, opens the Session and records Pod UID/provenance in one serialized operation
ADR 0002 — turning execution off ends attribution and no off Session exists; execution.md — Hot Session boundaries
ADR 0002 — Facts and related records: non-secret correlations (image digest, workload identity, runtime ids); ADR 0006
